limitations:
## Limitations

The evaluation uses a single Optum EHR data source and does not cover all
epidemiological tasks. EpiTrap tests one error per item rather than
end-to-end correctness. The fixed pipeline is not compute-matched to the agents,
and grading uses LLMs rather than humans. Usage findings are preliminary and
qualitative. Ascent does not estimate causal effects.
